scope.purpose: Deterministically identify duplicate and overlapping static help content across CareMetric EMR and CareMetric Breathe, then propose governed shared-core boundaries.
scope.comparison_unit: EMR grouped collections are expanded into the 218 verified primary authored units; all 135 Breathe manifest records are already compared as manifest entries.
scope.comparison_fields: Title tokens drive qualification. Title-plus-summary tokens are a corroborating Jaccard threshold. No embeddings, probabilistic model, runtime data, ticket text, or database content are used.
scope.excluded: Tickets, chat/free text, drafts, runtime customer/tenant/user/patient/organization records, secrets or credential values, tokenized URLs, and application query/hash context.
scope.publication_effect: None. This report does not publish content or mutate a repository, database, domain, support configuration, or production service.

atomic_expansion.public_faqs: one unit per verified FAQ question
atomic_expansion.in_app_faqs: one unit per verified FAQ question
atomic_expansion.troubleshooting: one unit per symptom/cause/resolution scenario plus one per quick check
atomic_expansion.quickstart: one unit per verified role track, matching the source inventory count
atomic_expansion.chatbot: one unit per verified intent; sample utterances are excluded from comparison units

basic: Unicode NFKD normalization and diacritic removal
singularization: words ending in ies become y when length exceeds four
words ending in sses lose es when length exceeds four
other words ending in s lose the final s when length exceeds three, except ss/us endings
title_normalization.set_rule: Tokens are unique and lexicographically sorted before comparison.

metrics.title_containment: |shared title tokens| / min(|EMR title tokens|, |Breathe title tokens|)
metrics.score_rounding: Four decimal places in output; thresholds are applied to unrounded values.

match_stages.E0: raw exact: trimmed titles are byte-for-byte equal
match_stages.E1: basic exact: E0 excluded; basic-normalized title strings are equal
match_stages.E2: normalized exact: E0/E1 excluded; ordered unique normalized title-token sets are equal and non-empty
match_stages.S1: likely semantic: not E0/E1/E2; at least two shared title tokens, title Jaccard >= 0.30, title+summary Jaccard >= 0.06, and at least one shared anchor
match_stages.S2: likely semantic: not E0/E1/E2/S1; at least two shared title tokens, title containment >= 0.50, title+summary Jaccard >= 0.10, and at least one shared anchor
match_stages.S3: likely semantic: not E0/E1/E2/S1/S2; at least one shared distinctive title token, title containment >= 0.50, and title+summary Jaccard >= 0.04

methodology.editorial_layer: Canonical groups and dispositions are explicit proposals over the deterministic candidate set and source guidance; they are not automatic publication decisions.

Define a separate approved secure workflow for any support investigation that truly requires protected data.

conflicting_guidance_requiring_human_rev.finding: Breathe says its in-app assistant explains navigation but does not change records, submit claims, place orders, alter settings, or provide clinical advice. EMR advertises AI-generated documentation, code suggestions, interaction checking, decision-support alerts, and other clinical features under user review. Preserve final human control for EMR suggestions, preserve Breathe no-clinical-advice/no-action limits, and never imply that the central support assistant can perform clinical or record-changing actions.

conflicting_guidance_requiring_human_rev.finding: EMR states a minimum seven-year retention period for application audit logs. recommendations: Resolve all critical/high review issues before importing any overlapping article.
Create shared-core articles only for the bounded reusable concepts above; store literal routes, roles, vendors, entitlements, clinical/billing rules, and regulatory claims in product overlays.
Use route placeholders and a product capability matrix instead of copying /admin and /dashboard navigation into core articles.

Keep support launch context limited to product key, static route template, and app version; never attach patient, user, tenant, organization, query/hash, screenshot, or free-text context automatically.
Import atomically with stable source keys and source commit metadata; do not import grouped EMR category shells as articles when their member questions are available.

Run the same deterministic matcher after every approved source import and require human approval for low-specificity normalized matches and every clinical, billing, security, SLA, or regulatory overlay.
